source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The initial Graph landing registers a local Cargo dependency, an aggregate extern crate, workspace membership and build traversal. Its new lib.rs contains only extern crate xpcom, so that landing supplies integration scaffolding rather than a working Graph client. The accepted constructor and interface declarations are later source phases, not evidence that this skeleton performed an operation. No build or Graph runtime was run.
title: The Graph bridge began with build registration before client implementation
